title: The golden values for the Berkshire-Hathaway dividend-rate/discount-rate sensitivity table are internally inconsistent: only row 10 (7.0%) is correct, rows 11–14 hold values for the wrong dividend rates, and the base-case row does not reproduce the model's own output.
evidence: Golden 'Berk-Hath Investment Package' F12=0.08 (=C12) gives I12=10429.31 and G12=11152.88, but the model at dividend 8%, discount ~7.3% gives ~11432–11468 (see C44=11432.17 and term-table I20=11468.40). G14 (9%)=12241.37 is the 8% value (it equals G20). Rows 11 and 12 are identical (values for 6.5%), and row 13 duplicates row 10. Any correct recalculation (LibreOffice MULTIPLE.OPERATIONS) will mismatch these cells.
